title: KASA: 8-Part Returning Series
description:
KASA is a vibrant, aspirational, thrill-filled whirlwind of glitz, gloss and greed – A white-

collar, crime family drama/thriller set in the corrupt world of high-stakes property


development. The series follows the lives of the seemingly ‘ordinary’ Green family as they

continue to expand their ‘extraordinary’ empire... with the help of a few unsavoury

‘friends’! With echoes of SEXY BEAST, THE OZARKS, BIG LITTLE LIES and NARCOS,

and an internationally diverse cast, KASA is a universally appealing returning series set in

Portugal and the U.K.


Available materials: Pilot Script, Series Outline, Pitch Deck.
